id: 18_Radiological Emergencies Get Your Lab Safety Now Training Course
title: 放射性物质洒漏怎么办
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/18_Radiological Emergencies Get Your Lab Safety Now Training Course.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/18_Radiological Emergencies Get Your Lab Safety Now Training Course/src.py

points.K3: 设屏障、拉警示带、人远离
points.K5: 防护穿戴齐全，佩戴剂量计
points.S1: 先培训持证，再做辐射工作

shots.scene: 欣欣站在贴有电离辐射警告标志的实验室门外，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands outside a lab door marked with an ionizing radiation warning sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲放射性物质洒漏怎么办。
overlay: 放射性物质洒漏怎么办

shots.scene: 隔离、防护、去污、检测、报告五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a barrier, a shield, a cleaning cloth, a radiation survey meter and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 隔离、防护、去污、检测、报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰在同位素实验室里不小心碰倒一支小试管，液体洒在托盘外
shots.prompt_en: In a radioisotope lab, the young male student accidentally knocks over a small tube and a few drops spill outside the tray.
shots.narration: 阿杰碰倒了一支装放射性溶液的小管。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起纸巾想擦，小研抬手拦住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student grabs paper towels to wipe it up, and the female graduate student raises a hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 他想马上擦掉，小研赶紧拦住。

shots.scene: 小研指着门口，示意先出去
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points toward the door, signaling him to step back and leave the area.
shots.narration: 先别动手，按应急程序来。

shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地站在电离辐射警告标志旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an ionizing radiation warning sign with a serious face.
shots.narration: 放射性事故不常见，但后果同样严重。

shots.scene: 看不见的射线箭头穿过空白区域，眼睛图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Faint ray arrows pass through an empty space next to an eye icon crossed out, showing radiation cannot be seen. No people.
shots.narration: 射线看不见、摸不着，更要按程序办。

shots.scene: 洒漏处周围画出一个红色圆圈
shots.prompt_en: A small spill on a lab bench with a red circle drawn around the area. No people.
shots.narration: 发生洒漏或泄漏，第一步是隔离现场。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研退到门外，关上门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student step out of the lab and close the door behind them.
shots.narration: 人员离开污染区域，不随意走动。

shots.section_title: 设屏障、拉警示带、人远离
shots.scene: 门口拉起警示带，立起电离辐射警告标志
shots.prompt_en: Warning tape is stretched across the lab doorway with an ionizing radiation warning sign on a stand. No people.
shots.narration: 设置屏障，拉起辐射警示带。
overlay: 设屏障、拉警示带、人远离

shots.section_title: 设屏障、拉警示带、人远离
shots.scene: 人群图标沿箭头远离隔离区
shots.prompt_en: Person pictograms move away from a taped-off area along arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 无关人员尽量远离。

shots.section_title: 设屏障、拉警示带、人远离
shots.scene: 污染区边缘的脚印图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of footprints crossing the taped line, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别把污染带出去。

shots.scene: 射线源图标与人之间立起一块屏蔽板
shots.prompt_en: A radiation source icon with a shielding block placed between it and a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 用屏蔽挡住射线，降低照射。

shots.scene: 不同射线配不同屏蔽板的图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a clear plastic shield for one kind of ray and a heavy metal shield for another kind of ray. No people.
shots.narration: 屏蔽材料按射线种类来选。

shots.section_title: 防护穿戴齐全，佩戴剂量计
shots.scene: 王老师帮小研穿戴防护服、手套，别上剂量计
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator helps the female graduate student put on a protective coverall and gloves and clip a dosimeter badge to her chest.
shots.narration: 处理前，防护穿戴要齐全。
overlay: 防护穿戴齐全，佩戴剂量计

shots.section_title: 防护穿戴齐全，佩戴剂量计
shots.scene: 防护服、双层手套、鞋套、剂量计四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a protective coverall, double gloves, shoe covers and a dosimeter badge. No people.
shots.narration: 防护服、手套、鞋套，必要时铅围裙。

shots.section_title: 防护穿戴齐全，佩戴剂量计
shots.scene: 剂量计图标旁有记录本
shots.prompt_en: A dosimeter badge icon next to a blank record book. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量计记录受照剂量。

shots.scene: 小研用吸水纸从洒漏边缘往中心覆盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in full protective gear, lays absorbent paper over the spill working from the edge toward the center.
shots.narration: 控制住洒漏后，再开始去污。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手用去污剂擦拭台面
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand wipes the bench surface with a cloth and a bottle of decontamination solution with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 用合适的去污剂，清洁受影响的表面。

shots.scene: 小研小心地由外向内卷起手套脱下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carefully peels off her outer gloves inside out at the edge of the area.
shots.narration: 小心脱下受污染的防护用品。

shots.scene: 小研用辐射检测仪扫查台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student scans the bench surface with a handheld radiation survey meter with a blank display.
shots.narration: 用检测仪逐处检测。

shots.scene: 检测仪表针回到正常区，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A survey meter needle drops back to the normal zone, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 确认达标，才能解除隔离。

shots.scene: 空白法规手册与电离辐射标志
shots.prompt_en: A blank regulation handbook next to an ionizing radiation warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 处理要依照国家法规和本校规程。

shots.scene: 时间、距离、屏蔽三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a stopwatch, a ruler with arrows showing distance, and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 原则是：照射合理可行，尽量低。

shots.scene: 抄近路的箭头被打叉，绕规范路线的箭头打勾
shots.prompt_en: A shortcut arrow crossed out with a red X, and a longer proper route arrow with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不走捷径，每一步都按程序。

shots.scene: 时钟图标旁，小人图标上方出现警示
shots.prompt_en: A calendar and clock icon beside a person pictogram with a small warning mark, showing long-term effects. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射影响可能很长远，能少一点是一点。

shots.section_title: 先培训持证，再做辐射工作
shots.scene: 王老师在培训室给学生讲辐射防护
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of students in a training room with a radiation warning sign on the blank screen.
shots.narration: 从事辐射工作，先参加培训考核。
overlay: 先培训持证，再做辐射工作

shots.section_title: 先培训持证，再做辐射工作
shots.scene: 小研领取空白的培训合格证和个人剂量计
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student receives a blank training certificate and a personal dosimeter badge.
shots.narration: 合格后上岗，佩戴个人剂量计。

shots.section_title: 先培训持证，再做辐射工作
shots.scene: 体检和剂量记录两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a medical checkup clipboard and a blank dose record chart. No people.
shots.narration: 定期剂量监测和职业健康检查。

shots.section_title: 先培训持证，再做辐射工作
shots.scene: 未受训的阿杰站在警示带外，不进入
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stays outside the warning tape and does not enter the area.
shots.narration: 没受过训练的人，不要自行处理。

shots.scene: 衣袖上出现沾污标记的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram with a small contamination mark on the sleeve. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤或衣物沾上了，

shots.scene: 脱下污染的外衣，装进专用袋
shots.prompt_en: A contaminated lab coat is removed and placed into a bag marked with an ionizing radiation warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 先脱去污染衣物，装袋。

shots.scene: 小研在水槽边用流水冲洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes her hands gently under running water at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 用流水轻轻冲洗，不用力搓。

shots.scene: 检测仪靠近手部检测
shots.prompt_en: A handheld survey meter is held near a person's hands to check them. No people.
shots.narration: 冲洗后检测，并马上报告。

shots.scene: 小研打电话，旁边是报告链条图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call; beside her are linked icons of a lab, a department building and a radiation safety office.
shots.narration: 发生洒漏，立即报告。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员赶来，协助封控现场
shots.prompt_en: The security officer arrives and helps keep people away from the taped-off lab door.
shots.narration: 同时通知保卫处，协助封控现场。

shots.scene: 空白应急预案文件和政府部门图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank emergency plan binder next to a government building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按条例和学校预案逐级上报。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有人受伤，先救治，拨打120。

shots.scene: 擦拭纸、手套放进带辐射标志的专用废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Used absorbent paper and gloves go into a waste bin marked with an ionizing radiation warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 擦拭物、手套都是放射性废物。

shots.scene: 把它们扔进普通垃圾桶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of contaminated gloves being thrown into an ordinary trash can, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能扔进普通垃圾桶。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白登记表上登记废物
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator records the waste bin in a blank radioactive waste log.
shots.narration: 登记后，交学校统一处置。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现隔离、屏蔽、去污图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a barrier, a shield and a cleaning cloth.
shots.narration: 先隔离，再防护，后去污。

shots.scene: 检测仪和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A survey meter icon and a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 检测确认，立即报告。

shots.scene: 时间、距离、屏蔽图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a stopwatch, a distance arrow and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 照射合理可行，尽量低。

shots.scene: 欣欣在辐射实验室门外挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye outside a lab door with an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 敬畏射线，按章操作，下次见！
